rules.why: architecture#packages / architecture#ownership-map: Webhooks (all but the outbox) -> webhooks (signing, SSRF guard, retry, secrets)
architecture#packages / architecture#ownership-map: Webhooks (all but the outbox) -> webhooks; the receiver-side verifier a host may use to check signatures
architecture#packages / architecture#ownership-map: Webhooks (all but the outbox) -> webhooks; domain event of the webhooks module consumed by host listeners
architecture#packages: OutboundUrlGuard and HostResolver contracts belong to webhooks and are overridden by hosts (baseline (core PublicApiSnapshot) lists it)
architecture#ownership-map: Jobs/Webhooks -> webhooks (queued job class names are a protocol identity, P2.3)
architecture#ownership-map: Http/Controllers/Webhooks -> webhooks (admin HTTP is identity surface, not PHP API)
architecture#ownership-map: Data by domain owner: webhook endpoint inputs/results; no PHP Operation exposes them
architecture#ownership-map: Exceptions by domain owner: webhook exceptions are rendered as problems; no PHP Operation throws them to hosts
architecture#ownership-map: ValueObjects by domain owner: pinned outbound endpoint of the SSRF guard
architecture#ownership-map: Policies -> webhooks (policy of webhook endpoints)
architecture#ownership-map: Console/{Relay,Retry,Redeliver,Prune}WebhooksCommand -> webhooks (prune; CLI is identity surface)
architecture#ownership-map: Console/{Relay,Retry,Redeliver,Prune}WebhooksCommand -> webhooks (redeliver; CLI is identity surface)
architecture#ownership-map: Console/{Relay,Retry,Redeliver,Prune}WebhooksCommand -> webhooks (retry; CLI is identity surface)
